Drag annotations to position them. Double-click text to edit. Select an image and drag its lower-right corner to resize. Save edited copy keeps annotations and embedded images.
Changes apply immediately. Save a copy to keep your edits. Matrix entries are row by row; SVD and eigenvectors are recalculated. No installation or internet is needed.


Use the positive-determinant example for a literal rotation–stretch–rotation animation. For a negative determinant an orthogonal factor includes a reflection; the transition then passes through a collapse. Arrow lengths represent actual transformed vectors. Source and equations: see README.md.
